name: Product configuration margin sheet
summary: When sales prepares a quote for a product configuration, the commercial owner and finance lead get one worksheet: the quoted price, the costed bill of materials, assembly and freight, and the allocations, with every unquoted part, one-off charge and uncertain volume listed as an open assumption.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of pricing one product configuration: a costed bill of materials, assembly and freight estimates and approved allocation rules set against the proposed price, with unquoted parts, one-off charges, uncertain volumes and omitted support costs kept visible as assumptions, finance validating the cost treatment and the commercial owner approving the price.
